de.hero_role: Senior Software Engineer · PHP · Symfony · Shopware

de.hero_p6: Hohe Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit gehörte bereits vor generativer KI zu meiner Arbeitsweise. Heute nutze ich KI gezielt als Werkzeug. Analyse, Architektur, Problemlösung und Codequalität bleiben weiterhin meine Verantwortung.
de.exp_tpg_desc:
Entwicklung einer Symfony-7-basierten Integrationsplattform für Shopware- und Shopify-Shops zur Anbindung an ein internes ERP-System.
  • Eigenständige Konzeption und Entwicklung einer Shopware-App von der ersten Codezeile bis zum produktiven Deployment
  • Implementierung einer bidirektionalen Produkt- und Bestellsynchronisation mit konfigurierbarem Attribut- und Kategorie-Mapping
  • Aufbau einer Message-Queue-basierten Architektur (Symfony Messenger, Redis) zur asynchronen Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen inklusive automatischem Crash-Recovery
  • Eigenständiger Aufbau von Staging- und Produktionsinfrastruktur mit Reverse Proxy, TLS und automatisierten Datenbank-Backups
  • Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb mehrerer Marktplatz-Integrationen sowie Optimierung bestehender Shopify-Synchronisationen
  • Bereits im ersten Monat die Ursache massiver Shopware-Performanceprobleme eigenständig analysiert und als Plugin in rund zwei Wochen behoben – ca. 1 TB ungenutzte Produktbilder sicher entfernt, Shop deutlich beschleunigt
  • Eigenes KI-Tool für Entwickler gebaut (analysiert Pull Requests, führt Jira-Tickets zusammen, generiert Testanweisungen) – im Einsatz bei über 20 Entwicklern
de.exp_side_desc: Konzeption, Entwicklung und Betrieb eigener Softwareprodukte als Ein-Personen-Projekte – aktuell Parkingsoft (Parkmanagement) und SecureTime (siehe Projektauswahl). Vollständige Verantwortung von Architektur, Backend und Frontend über Mobile App bis zu Infrastruktur, Deployment und Support. Alle Kennzahlen und Details zur Plattform in der Projektauswahl.
de.exp_ito_desc:
Entwicklung von Symfony-Anwendungen und Shopware-Plugins, u. a. für eine Personaleinsatz-Software im Einsatz bei rund 200 Zahnarztpraxen (10–60 Mitarbeiter). Sämtliche Projekte in dieser Zeit ohne generative KI umgesetzt.
  • Eigenes Benchmark-System entwickelt, das sämtliche API-Endpunkte automatisch misst (Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleich); typische langsame Endpunkte von ca. 30 Sekunden auf ca. 2 Sekunden reduziert, der schwerste von über 6 Minuten auf ca. 2 Sekunden
  • Als erster Entwickler im Team Unit Tests eingeführt – inkl. interner Präsentationen und Unterstützung der Kollegen beim Einstieg
  • Datafox-Zeiterfassungslösung komplett eigenständig entwickelt – Details in der Projektauswahl
  • Mitwirkung an der Symfony-7-Migration
  • Administration von Linux-Servern (Virtualmin, Apache2), CI/CD mit Git, Einarbeitung von Auszubildenden
de.exp_evt_desc: Einstieg in die Webentwicklung (PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, WordPress): Kundenanforderungen verstehen, Umsetzung in kleinen bis mittleren Projekten, erste Erfahrung mit Abstimmung und praktischer Umsetzung im Team.

en.meta_desc: Pavel Tyulnev – Senior Software Engineer (PHP, Symfony, Shopware). 8+ years: software architecture, performance optimization, API integrations, self-built SaaS platforms. Germany.
en.hero_role: Senior Software Engineer · PHP · Symfony · Shopware
en.hero_p1: Senior software engineer with more than eight years of experience in PHP and Symfony. My goal is not to build some technical solution as fast as possible, but first to find out which problem actually needs to be solved.
en.hero_p2: To do that, I ask a lot of questions: Which processes cost the most time? Where do errors, unnecessary work, or frustration arise? Which risks have been overlooked so far? I think beyond the original requirement and develop solutions from it that genuinely improve the business process.
en.hero_p3: I support projects end to end: from analysis and architecture through development to deployment, operations, and support. Along the way I give regular, understandable feedback, document decisions, and make progress, risks, and open questions transparent. The client always knows what's being worked on and what the current status is. New insights continuously feed back into the implementation.
en.hero_p4: My technical focus areas are backend systems, integration platforms, API design, performance optimization, and digitizing complex business processes. To me, quality means testable code, clean domain models, and an architecture that remains extendable years later.
en.hero_p5: I have independently conceived, built, and launched several platforms. Alongside my permanent role, I develop and operate the SaaS products ParkingSoft and SecureTime, including infrastructure, deployment, and support.
en.hero_p6: High delivery speed was part of how I worked even before generative AI. Today I use AI deliberately as a tool. Analysis, architecture, problem solving, and code quality remain my responsibility.
en.exp_tpg_desc:
Development of a Symfony 7 based integration platform for Shopware and Shopify shops connecting to an internal ERP system.
  • Independent design and development of a Shopware app from the first line of code to production deployment
  • Implementation of bidirectional product and order synchronization with configurable attribute and category mapping
  • Message-queue-based architecture (Symfony Messenger, Redis) for asynchronous processing of large data volumes, including automatic crash recovery
  • Independently set up staging and production infrastructure with reverse proxy, TLS, and automated database backups
  • Evolution and operation of several marketplace integrations plus optimization of existing Shopify synchronizations
  • Within the first month, independently analyzed the root cause of massive Shopware performance problems and fixed it with a plugin in about two weeks – safely removing ~1 TB of unused product images and speeding up the shop significantly
  • Built an internal AI tool for developers (analyzes pull requests, consolidates Jira tickets, generates test instructions) – used by more than 20 developers
en.exp_side_desc: Design, development, and operation of my own software products as one-person projects – currently Parkingsoft (parking management) and SecureTime (see project selection). Full responsibility from architecture, backend, and frontend through the mobile app to infrastructure, deployment, and support. All key figures and platform details in the project selection.
en.exp_ito_desc:
Development of Symfony applications and Shopware plugins, including a workforce-planning product used by around 200 dental practices (10–60 employees each). All projects in this period were delivered without generative AI.
  • Built my own benchmark system that automatically measures all API endpoints (before/after comparison); typical slow endpoints reduced from ~30 seconds to ~2 seconds, the worst one from over 6 minutes to ~2 seconds
  • First developer on the team to introduce unit tests – including internal presentations and helping colleagues get started
  • Built the Datafox time-tracking solution entirely on my own – details in the project selection
  • Contributed to the Symfony 7 migration
  • Linux server administration (Virtualmin, Apache2), CI/CD with Git, onboarding of trainees
en.exp_evt_desc: Introduction to web development (PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, WordPress): understanding client requirements, delivery in small to medium projects, first experience coordinating and implementing work in a team.
en.edu1_desc: Hands-on software engineering, web applications, and current development practices.
en.work_1_d: Software as the interplay of architecture, interfaces, data model, and operations—not isolated features.
en.work_2_d: Translating business asks into robust technical contracts; surfacing alternatives when the obvious path becomes expensive long term.
en.work_3_d: Success in numbers: load times, throughput, saved working hours, revenue. Using tools – including AI – deliberately to reach results faster, without handing over architecture or code quality.
